algorithm: signature verification by algorithm over SubjectPublicKeyInfo
source: scripts/gen_sig_vectors.py with pyca/cryptography 50.0.0 (OpenSSL 4.0.1 9 Jun 2026). Keys generated and discarded; ECDSA signatures are DER Ecdsa-Sig-Value, RSA-PSS uses MGF1 with the same hash and a salt as long as the hash. Interoperability vectors from an independent implementation, not values from a standard.
